scripts.dev: npm run clean && powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .next\server | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path .next\server\middleware-manifest.json)) { Set-Content -Encoding utf8 .next\server\middleware-manifest.json '{}' }" && next dev
scripts.postbuild: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .next\server | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path .next\server\middleware-manifest.json)) { Set-Content -Encoding utf8 .next\server\middleware-manifest.json '{}' }"
scripts.prestart: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .next\server | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path .next\server\middleware-manifest.json)) { Set-Content -Encoding utf8 .next\server\middleware-manifest.json '{}' }"
